long_biography.plain_text:
Azizov began in payments and professional trading before founding B2BROKER in 2014. The company was designed to provide brokers and financial institutions with liquidity, trading platforms and supporting infrastructure. He later established B2BINPAY for business-focused digital-asset payments, extending the group from foreign-exchange technology into cryptocurrency services.

Today he remains the founder and public leader of both businesses, using the professional spelling Arthur while his legal corporate name is Artur Shamilyevich Azizov. He holds majority control of EQWIRE UK and has served in regulated brokerage entities in Russia and Dubai. Together, these holdings show that he built and controls parts of the operating platform, although neither a complete valuation nor every group-company percentage is disclosed. His principal business remains financial technology, combining institutional brokerage infrastructure, software and digital payments.
